jobs.title: Apply uniform control states and explicit empty/loading/error states
jobs.objective: Apply, from the Slice 1 state + focus-ring tokens, a uniform default/hover/focus/active/disabled treatment to every button, select, slider, toggle, and tab across the shell and Generate panel (this reintroduces, uniformly, the control focus-ring/:focus-visible treatment deliberately deferred out of Slice 2 per workflow 0059 ledger S1 — now applied to all controls, not a partial subset). Honestly-disabled controls MUST stay disabled and keep their explanatory copy byte-identical: the watertight-solid readiness option ('Current generated packages do not satisfy watertight-solid readiness.'), the disabled EXPORT_MENU_ROWS rows (keep aria-disabled + their copy), the Cm reserved-preset case, and the generative_submit_disabled buttons with their blocking-reason copy. Add explicit, consistent empty/loading/error states with stable data-testid hooks for every panel that waits on or can fail to load data: the Generate jobs table (empty / running / failed via GenerativeJobError.kind / cancelled / resumable), the Pareto frontier scatter (loading / empty / rendered), Comparison (no-report vs report-present: comparison-live-frontier-block / comparison-imported-report-block), Mesh (mesh-no-package-chip vs mesh-live-readiness-chip), CFD (no-job vs status states with BOTH persistent banners intact), and the Share-URL-load (share-url-state) + invalid-hull-state banners. Restyle these states for consistency; their COPY — especially any claim/availability copy — is unchanged. Style only through theme tokens (no new inline dimension/radius/elevation/border/colour literal; the widened tests/test_ui_theme.py orphan lint stays green); if a genuine token gap appears, add it ADDITIVELY to kayakgen/ui/theme.py per Slice 1 D1 and extend CONTRAST_MANIFEST + the lint. Preserve the Slice 2 layout contract: the region-params/-geometry/-review test-ids, the four status segments, the 1440x900 first-viewport contract, and the <=960px collapse hooks. Reflect every renamed/moved/new data-testid/kg-* hook in tests/test_web_layout.py AND tests/test_web_inline_help.py in this slice, and EXTEND the forbidden-copy / no-go scan in tests/test_web_layout.py to cover every NEW rendered string (state messages, ARIA labels, tooltips). Claim line byte-stable: touch no CHIP_SPECS/CHIP_LABELS/CHIP_CLASSES text or class, recolour no chip into the success palette, keep every persistent caption (resistance, high-angle GZ, CFD local/artifact, not-watertight-cfd_ready) byte-identical, keep the RFC 0033 section 8 no-go list absent. Add no REST route or claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal (RFC 0032 boundary). Docs: CHANGELOG.md only; do NOT touch docs/USER_GUIDE.md or docs/WEB_VERIFICATION.md (Slice 4); do not ratify DECISION_LOG D047. See SLICE_3_DECISIONS.md D1-D8.

jobs.title: Review traceability to RFC 0065 Slice 3 decisions
jobs.objective: Review every workflow 0060 change for traceability to RFC 0065 section 3 and SLICE_3_DECISIONS.md (D1-D8). Flag scope creep: any layout/hierarchy re-flow beyond control + state styling (Slice 2 boundary), any token re-typing/removal (Slice 1 boundary), any harness or WEB_VERIFICATION.md/USER_GUIDE.md change or D047 ratification (Slice 4), any touched CHIP_* entry or persistent caption, any recoloured chip, any new REST route/claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal. Confirm control states (default/hover/focus/active/disabled) derive from Slice 1 tokens and apply uniformly; honestly-disabled controls keep their explanatory copy; each panel renders an explicit empty/loading/error state with a stable data-testid hook; state copy is byte-stable; styling is token-only (orphan lint green); every new/renamed hook is reflected in tests/test_web_layout.py + tests/test_web_inline_help.py; and the forbidden-copy scan was extended to cover every new rendered string.

jobs.title: Review claims and user-facing boundaries
jobs.objective: Review every workflow 0060 change for claim truthfulness. Confirm CHIP_SPECS/CHIP_LABELS/CHIP_CLASSES are byte-identical and no chip is recoloured into the success palette; every persistent caption (resistance, high-angle GZ, CFD local/artifact banners, not-watertight-cfd_ready negation) is byte-identical; the honestly-disabled controls (watertight-solid, disabled EXPORT_MENU_ROWS, Cm reserved-preset, generative_submit_disabled) stay disabled and keep their explanatory copy verbatim — disabling is a truthfulness affordance and must not be silently enabled or have its copy softened; every NEW rendered string introduced by the empty/loading/error states (state messages, ARIA labels, tooltips) carries no claim/validation semantics and is covered by the extended forbidden-copy scan; no new claim_state/Readiness/accepted_uses literal and no new REST route (RFC 0032 boundary); the RFC 0033 section 8 no-go list stays absent. No empty/loading/error treatment may make an unvalidated/raw/failed result read as a confident, validated, or successful claim.

jobs.title: Review tests, determinism, and operational behaviour
jobs.objective: Review workflow 0060 tests for determinism and coverage. Confirm each new empty/loading/error-state hook has a positive assertion in tests/test_web_layout.py or tests/test_web_inline_help.py (Generate jobs table empty/running/failed/cancelled/resumable; frontier loading/empty/rendered; comparison no-report vs present; mesh no-package vs live-readiness; CFD no-job vs status; share-url + invalid-hull banners); the forbidden-copy / no-go scan in tests/test_web_layout.py was EXTENDED to the new rendered strings (and still passes); the honestly-disabled control states are asserted (disabled + aria-disabled + copy); the Slice 2 region/status/collapse hooks and the 1440x900 first-viewport assertion still pass; the widened orphan-literal lint stays green (token-only styling); the desktop rendered-bbox tests stay green; and the full repo suite minus env-gated smoke is green (the known NB-2 services-import-boundary failure is pre-existing and out of scope) with git diff --check passing. Tests must not depend on wall-clock sleeps; loading-state tests must be deterministic (no real timers).

jobs.title: Build findings ledger
jobs.objective: Deduplicate the three review findings into must-fix remediation items and non-blocking successor items (pointing at a later RFC 0065 slice where appropriate) without inventing new design scope. Cross-check each finding against SLICE_3_DECISIONS.md; a finding that would reopen a settled decision belongs in the non-blocking successor bucket with an explicit pointer. Treat the known NB-2 services-import-boundary failure as a non-blocking successor (follow-up hygiene workflow), not a Slice 3 remediation item.

jobs.title: Remediate review findings
jobs.objective: Fix the must-fix findings from the ledger, update CHANGELOG.md and this workflow's OPERATOR_REPORT.md, and preserve all SLICE_3_DECISIONS.md decisions and the no-claims boundaries (token-only styling, byte-stable claim line and state copy, honestly-disabled controls kept disabled with their copy, every hook change reflected in the layout/inline-help tests, the forbidden-copy scan extended, Slice 2 layout contract intact, USER_GUIDE.md/WEB_VERIFICATION.md untouched, D047 not ratified). Run tests/test_web_layout.py, tests/test_web_inline_help.py, tests/test_ui_theme.py, the desktop rendered-bbox tests, and the full repo suite minus the env-gated smoke before publishing.
